cases.name: Serenity Anne McKinney
cases.about: The family said they were left with only memories of a beautiful little girl, saying Serenity was a budding singer, puzzle solver, fisher and princess. Her obituary said, "Born into this world, a shining star. A new light on whomever she crossed paths with. An angel born into this world, but called home entirely too soon. Forever her memory will live on through all of us."
cases.narrative: On 2/18/2022, Serenity's decomposing body was found abandoned in a suitcase, filled with a sand-like substance, in a wooded area. She had been wrapped in plastic and she suffered fractures to her arms and legs. Although the coroner said she died by homicide, her cause of death remained undetermined.
